definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 clause 3 has no entry for it (3.153 relative item, 3.156 report writer, nothing between), and its meaning in 2023 rests on §2023:13.8.1 and §2023:13.14.1, word-identical to §2002:13.7 and §2002:13.12 (the report section describes the reports to be written to report files; each report begins with an RD entry; 13.18.46.2 is only the REPORT clause format). The rule's page limit comes from the RD PAGE clause of the report in both editions; the dropped definition changes neither the a)-b) cases nor the witnesses.
